Definition: from G3641 and G5590; little-spirited, i.e. faint-hearted:--feebleminded.
BiblicalUsage: Oligopsychos means faint-hearted, little-spirited, the feebleminded. It occurs once, in 1 Thessalonians 5:14, where Paul says to comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, and be patient toward all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the faint-hearted are to be comforted, not scolded, and patience toward all is the church's work.
